info.title: HOTEL PMS SAAS - Phase 8 implemented operations
info.description: Operations implemented in Phase 8 packages P08-01..P08-06 (backend): finance core, folios, collections, corrections, billing (invoice/credit-note series with duplicate-safe numbering, EX-03 gate for production issuance, and cashier sessions that record the counted truth and never erase the variance), and the P08-06 integration of financial clearance with operational checkout (departed is not settled: CLEARED requires posted payments/refunds or a routed liability to an authorized COMPANY payer with a documented collection plan), external-booking settlement listing with gross/net/commission kept separate, and long-stay schedules/packages surfaced through the clearance view. Account/invoice/cashier UI stays for the remaining work.

Date.name: date
Date.description: Optional business date in the property timezone; defaults to the current local date

Error.description: Fixed error code, localized message key, correlation id and bounded details without secrets

departed.description: Operational departure only; never implies the reservation is financially settled

balanced.description: Every reservation folio has balance_due exactly zero

outstanding.description: At least one folio has a positive balance due

credit.description: At least one folio has a credit balance that needs a refund before settlement

payer_folio_id.description: Required for TRANSFER_TO_PAYER: an open COMPANY city-ledger folio not linked to this reservation

collection_plan_ref.description: Required for TRANSFER_TO_PAYER: documented collection plan reference

amount.description: Net transfer amount; no currency conversion is applied

200.description: The property-local business date, timezone and the requested or active business day
The requested day is closed and the next property-local day is opened atomically
Folios in the property, optionally filtered by reservation or state
The opened folio with its currency and payer label
The folio with charges, routed allocations, deposits, package entitlements, schedules and derived totals
The posted charge with its immutable policy snapshot and journal reference
Payer allocations without duplicating the posted revenue
The recurring charge schedule
One accrual period posted once; a duplicate period cannot post twice
The package entitlement with its quantity and unit price
Package consumption that posts one charge and cannot be duplicated
A deposit or damage deposit held as a liability, never revenue
A justified deposit application against an outstanding charge
A justified release that moves the liability to refund clearing, not revenue
Payments in the property, optionally filtered by folio or state
A recorded collection; OTA settlements keep gross, net and commission separate and UNKNOWN stays unresolved without a journal
The payment with its journal lines when resolved
Resolves an UNKNOWN payment once; SUCCEEDED posts the single collection journal and FAILED posts none
A refund reserved against the collected amount with its own independent approval request; no payout is claimed
Resolves a reserved refund once: PENDING waits for evidence, SUCCEEDED posts the single refund journal with an approved independent approval, FAILED releases the reservation
A single full reversal journal; the original posted charge is never edited or deleted
A documented adjustment journal linked to the original; negative and positive adjustments never rewrite the original
Requests an independent approval for a documented settlement rate; no live FX provider and no conversion posting
Approved FX snapshots in the property
Records one approved FX snapshot; one snapshot per approval and no direct exchange
Issued invoices with their credit notes
One issued invoice with a duplicate-safe series number; a PRODUCTION series without an approved EX-03 profile is rejected while synthetic issuance stays allowed
A linked credit note that never exceeds the invoice total and posts one correction journal
Cashier sessions in the property
One open session per currency with its opening float
The counted truth recorded beside the expected amount; the variance is stored and never erased
Closes a reconciled session and preserves its variance

get.description: Tracks the reservation liability after departure: folio balances (payments, refunds, deposits, routing and corrections), invoices, long-stay schedules/packages and the external booking link. departed=true never means settled.

200.description: Clearance state and the posted financial facts behind it, grouped by currency without conversion

post.description: Resolves a PENDING clearance only with evidence: SETTLED requires every reservation folio at balance zero through posted payments/deposits/refunds/routing; TRANSFER_TO_PAYER routes the outstanding balances to an open COMPANY city-ledger folio with a documented collection plan reference. Departed alone never clears.

200.description: The cleared reservation with its basis, plan reference and transfer allocations

get.description: Lists OTA settlements with gross, net and commission kept separate, their reference/evidence and their external-booking link. No FX conversion is applied or implied.

200.description: External settlements linked to their folio, reservation and external booking when one exists
